verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted runtime that runs on local hardware, including a CI-tested CPU path. It claims voice support and 'speech in … over WebRTC, fast enough to feel like a conversation', which implies real-time local speech recognition. However, the evidence frames this as a voice-conversation pipeline, not a dictation or transcription feature that returns text to the user. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a speech-to-text/transcription endpoint or dictation UX, confirmation of streaming real-time transcript output, named on-device ASR models, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
